question: The average age of 40 students in a class is 16 years. When a new student is admitted, the average increases by 0.2 years. What is the age of the new student?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Age of new student = Old Average + (New Total Members × Increase in Average)

Old Average = 16 years

New Total Members = 40 + 1 = 41 students

Increase in Average = 0.2 years

Age of new student = 16 + (41 × 0.2) = 16 + 8.2 = 24.2 years

**∴ The correct answer is 24.2 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Average age of 40 students = 16 years

⇒ Increase in average age = 0.2 years

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Total Age = Number of Students × Average Age

⇒ Age of New Student = Total age of new group − Total age of old group

 
 40 Students
 Average = 16

 41 Students (Total)
 New Average = 16.2 (+0.2)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 40 students = 40 × 16 = 640 years

⇒ Total students after admission = 40 + 1 = 41

⇒ New average age = 16 + 0.2 = 16.2 years

⇒ Total age of 41 students = 41 × 16.2 = 664.2 years

⇒ Age of the new student = 664.2 − 640 = 24.2 years

**∴ The correct answer is 24.2 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

1. Weighted Average

When combining two different groups, the overall combined average is calculated as A = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

2. Replacement in Average

If an existing person is replaced by a new person and the average changes, the value of the new person = Value of removed person + (Total members × Change in average).

3. Person Leaving a Group

When a person leaves the group, their age/value can be found directly by: Value = Old Average − (Remaining Members × Change in average).
